families.name: Hydrolytic bond cleavage
families.v2_split_note: metal_dependent_hydrolase is the coarse v1 umbrella (kept for the frozen-702 and pre-2026-06-11 expansion rows). Its v2 sub-families separate the distinct reaction-center bond change + metal architecture: metallopeptidase (peptide C-N), metallophosphoesterase_nuclease (phosphodiester P-O, two-metal), metallophosphomonoesterase (phosphomonoester P-O, di-metal), metallo_amidohydrolase_deaminase (non-peptide amide/amidine C-N). New bronze is sourced to the sub-families, not the umbrella.
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not propagate labels across glycosidase, thiol protease, phosphorolysis, or nonhydrolytic metal-transfer chemistry without mechanism-text support.
Treat metal ligation as insufficient for hydrolase propagation unless water activation or hydrolytic bond cleavage is explicit.

Keep the four metal sub-families separated by reaction-center bond change, not by metal alone: peptide C-N (peptidase) vs phosphodiester P-O (phosphoesterase/nuclease) vs phosphomonoester P-O (phosphomonoesterase) vs non-peptide amide/amidine C-N (amidohydrolase/deaminase).

Require an annotated catalytic divalent metal before assigning any metal sub-family; this excludes Cys-based protein-tyrosine phosphatases (3.1.3.48) and serine hydrolases, which carry no catalytic metal.
Do not add new labels to the coarse metal_dependent_hydrolase umbrella; route new metal-hydrolase bronze to the matching v2 sub-family.

families.name: ATP-dependent phosphoryl transfer
families.scope_note: Parent family for expert-reviewed ATP phosphoryl-transfer and ATP-coupled phospho-intermediate lanes surfaced by reaction/substrate mismatch review. This family is ontology boundary evidence only until a row has direct local mechanistic support and a countable seed fingerprint.
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not collapse ATP/Mg2+ phosphoryl-transfer or phospho-intermediate chemistry into metal hydrolase labels solely because ATP-bound Mg2+ or metal coordination is present.
Keep family assignments review-only unless local reaction-center evidence supports phosphoryl transfer and countable-import gates explicitly allow the label.

families.name: ePK-fold protein and ePK-like kinases
families.scope_note: Protein, lipid, and ePK-like antibiotic-resistance kinases using ATP gamma-phosphoryl transfer to hydroxyl acceptors. Includes ePK/RTK/MAPK-family and ePK-related lanes; excludes GHKL histidine kinases and ASKHA/Pfk sugar kinases.
family_boundary_guardrails: Treat ATP-bound Mg2+ as phosphoryl-transfer cofactor evidence, not as metal-hydrolase catalytic evidence.
Do not propagate from ePK-like names into countable labels without local acceptor-hydroxyl and ATP gamma-phosphate evidence.

families.name: ASKHA sugar and acetate kinases
families.scope_note: Actin-like/ASKHA kinases including hexokinase/glucokinase and acetate kinase lanes with ATP gamma-phosphoryl transfer to sugar hydroxyls or carboxylates.
family_boundary_guardrails: Keep hexokinase/glucokinase/acetate kinase review lanes out of hydrolase labels even when Mg2+ is local.
Do not merge ASKHA sugar kinases with PfkA, PfkB, or GHMP solely by ATP wording.

families.name: ATP-grasp ligases
families.scope_note: ATP-grasp and related ATP-dependent amide ligases that form acyl-phosphate or related phosphorylated intermediates before C-N ligation. This is ATP-coupled transfer/ligation chemistry, not hydrolytic bond cleavage.
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by ATP/ADP/phosphate or Mg context plus Ligase/ATP-grasp/domain, Rhea C-N/amide ligation, or active-/binding-site evidence; EC 6.3 is scope only.
Do not count ATP-grasp rows as hydrolases because a phospho-intermediate later collapses.
Hold biotin carboxylases, kinases/phosphotransferases, generic ATP-transferases, hydrolase side rows, and multi-fingerprint-signal rows rather than forcing an ATP amide ligase label.

families.name: GHKL/Bergerat ATP-binding kinases
families.scope_note: Bergerat/GHKL ATP-binding kinases such as histidine kinases and pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase lanes. Kept separate from ePK and hydrolase chemistry.
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not propagate ePK rules into GHKL histidine-kinase or PDK lanes.
Local ATP/Mg2+ support must be interpreted as GHKL transfer evidence only with matching family context.

families.name: Deoxynucleoside kinases
families.scope_note: dNK-fold nucleoside kinases that transfer ATP gamma-phosphate to deoxynucleoside 5-prime hydroxyl acceptors. Kept separate from NDK phosphohistidine exchange.
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not merge dNK substrate hydroxyl phosphorylation with NDK ping-pong phosphohistidine chemistry.
Keep dNK lanes review-only until substrate-class and local phosphoryl-transfer evidence are explicit.

families.name: Nucleoside diphosphate kinases
families.scope_note: NDK-family nucleotide phosphate-transfer lanes using a phosphohistidine intermediate to exchange phosphate between nucleotides.
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not propagate NDK phosphohistidine chemistry into dNK substrate-hydroxyl phosphorylation.
Do not treat nucleotide phosphate transfer as metal hydrolase chemistry based on Mg2+ alone.

families.name: PfkA-fold phosphofructokinases
families.scope_note: PfkA-fold phosphofructokinase lanes transferring ATP gamma-phosphate to fructose-6-phosphate. Kept separate from PfkB ribokinase-like folds and ASKHA hexokinases.
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not infer PfkA from generic sugar kinase text without phosphofructokinase/PfkA evidence.
PfkA lanes remain hydrolase boundary controls until countable seed evidence is added.

families.name: PfkB/ribokinase-family kinases
families.scope_note: Ribokinase/PfkB-superfamily lanes including ribokinase and hydroxymethylpyrimidine kinase, transferring ATP gamma-phosphate to small-molecule hydroxyl acceptors.
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not collapse PfkB/ribokinase lanes into PfkA or ASKHA solely by sugar-kinase wording.
Keep PfkB family evidence review-only when local active-site support is incomplete.

families.name: GHMP-superfamily kinases
families.scope_note: GHMP-superfamily kinase lanes such as CDP-ME kinase, mevalonate-family kinase chemistry, and related ATP gamma-phosphoryl transfers. Kept separate from ASKHA, PfkA, and PfkB sugar kinases.
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not identify GHMP from ATP text alone; require GHMP-family or substrate-class evidence.
Do not count GHMP rows as hydrolases when ATP/Mg2+ is the local cofactor context.

families.name: Metal-stabilized carbon-carbon lyase chemistry
families.scope_note: Class-II metal aldolases and related oxo-acid lyases that use a divalent metal to stabilize enolate/enediolate C-C bond cleavage or formation.
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by metal cofactor/site evidence plus Lyase/aldolase/domain, Rhea C-C/oxoacid reaction context, active-/binding-/metal-site evidence, or structure; EC 4.1.2/4.1.3 is scope only.
Do not admit PLP-dependent lyases, ThDP-dependent enzymes, or class-I Schiff-base aldolases into this family.
Hold hydrolase, transferase, oxidoreductase, non-4.1.2/4.1.3 side-EC, and multi-fingerprint-signal rows rather than forcing a class-II metal aldolase label.

The catalytic metal, oxoacid/aldehyde substrate, and enolate C-C reaction geometry are deploy-missing and must remain review-only admission evidence until source-free geometry or grafted context supports silver promotion.

families.name: Pyridoxal-phosphate chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not propagate between PLP decarboxylation, transamination, racemization, and beta-elimination subclasses without active-site lysine and substrate-class agreement.

families.name: Radical rearrangement chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not propagate radical labels between SAM/Fe-S and adenosylcobalamin systems solely by radical wording.
Require cofactor-family support or explicit mechanism text before treating radical families as compatible.

families.name: Flavin redox chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Separate oxygen insertion from hydride-transfer redox unless FAD/FMN context and reaction-center text support the subclass.
NAD-only hydride transfer is not enough to propagate a flavin label.

families.name: Heme peroxide and oxidase chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Do not propagate from generic heme or electron-transfer proteins into peroxide activation without distal activation residue or peroxide/oxygen chemistry support.

families.name: Cytochrome P450 heme-thiolate monooxygenation
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by heme plus P450/monooxygenase mechanism evidence (keyword/domain, heme-thiolate binding, or O2 monooxygenase Rhea participant) with EC 1.14 as scope only.
Do not merge peroxidases, peroxide-substrate EC 1.11 chemistry, or generic heme electron-transfer proteins into P450 labels.
Do not merge flavin-only monooxygenases into P450; the heme-thiolate axis must be present or the row stays held.
Heme/O2/reductant/substrate context is deploy-missing and must remain review-only admission evidence until source-free geometry or grafted context supports silver promotion.

families.name: Non-heme iron 2-oxoglutarate oxygenation
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by Fe(II)/non-heme metal plus 2-oxoglutarate/succinate/CO2 or Dioxygenase mechanism evidence with EC 1.14.11 as scope only.
Do not merge heme/P450 monooxygenases, flavin monooxygenases, or peroxide/peroxidase chemistry into this family.
Do not merge generic iron proteins into 2OG dioxygenase without 2-oxoglutarate or dioxygenase mechanism evidence.
Fe(II), 2-oxoglutarate, O2, and substrate are deploy-missing and must remain review-only admission evidence until source-free geometry or grafted context supports silver promotion.

families.name: Molybdopterin metal-center redox chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by molybdopterin/Mo-cofactor or Mo-pterin feature evidence plus Rhea redox/oxo-transfer, Molybdenum keyword/domain, active-/binding-/metal-site, or structure support; EC 1.* is scope only.
Do not merge heme/P450, flavin-only, copper-only, peroxidase, hydrolase, or non-oxidoreductase boundary rows into this family without explicit Mo-cofactor mechanism evidence.
Hold multi-fingerprint-signal rows where heme/flavin/copper/peroxidase chemistry independently satisfies another fingerprint.

Mo-cofactor, terminal oxo/sulfido ligand, electron relay, and substrate context are deploy-missing and must remain review-only admission evidence until source-free geometry or grafted context supports silver promotion.

families.name: Copper-center oxidoreductase chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by Copper keyword/domain plus copper cofactor/feature, Rhea oxygen/redox equation, or active-/binding-/metal-site evidence; EC 1.10.3 / 1.4.3 is scope only.
Do not merge heme/P450, flavin-only, molybdopterin/Mo, hydrolase, glycosyltransferase, or non-oxidoreductase boundary rows into this family.
Hold EC-only rows and multi-fingerprint-signal rows rather than forcing a copper label.

Copper center, O2 or quinone redox partner, and substrate context are deploy-missing and must remain review-only admission evidence until source-free geometry or grafted context supports silver promotion.

families.name: NAD(P)-dependent hydride-transfer redox chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by the NAD(P) cosubstrate (Rhea nicotinamide participant or NAD/NADP keyword) plus a dinucleotide-binding signature, NOT by EC scope alone (EC 1.1.1 selects the lane only).
Do not propagate from a flavin/PQQ/F420 hydride donor or from an oxygen-incorporating oxygenase reaction; the cosubstrate must be NAD(P).
NAD(P) is a dissociable cosubstrate, not a prosthetic cofactor; its absence in the apo structure is the declared deploy-missing context.

families.name: Nucleotide-sugar-dependent glycosyl transfer chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by the nucleotide-sugar donor (Rhea UDP/GDP/dTDP/CMP-sugar participant) or the Glycosyltransferase family keyword plus a donor/acceptor signature, NOT by EC scope alone (EC 2.4 selects the lane only).
Do not propagate from a glycoside hydrolase (EC 3.2) or a phosphoryl-transfer enzyme; the donor must be a nucleotide sugar.
The nucleotide-sugar donor (and GT-A bridging metal) is a dissociable substrate, not a prosthetic cofactor; its absence in the apo structure is the declared deploy-missing context.

families.name: SAM-dependent methyl transfer chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by SAM/SAH methyl-donor evidence (Rhea participant, SAM/SAH binding evidence, or Methyltransferase keyword) plus EC 2.1.1 scope, NOT by EC scope alone.
Do not propagate radical-SAM methylases into this family; Fe-S cluster evidence or a CxxxCxxC radical-SAM motif blocks the polar SAM methyltransferase label.
Do not merge folate/PLP one-carbon transfer, glycine hydroxymethyltransferase, or phosphoryl/glycosyl transfer chemistry into SAM methyl transfer solely by methyl-transfer wording.
The SAM methyl donor and SAH product are dissociable ligands; their absence in the apo structure is the declared deploy-missing context.

families.name: CoA/acyl-CoA-dependent acyl transfer chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by CoA/acyl-CoA Rhea participant or CoA/acyl-CoA binding-site evidence, or by Acyltransferase keyword/domain plus active-/binding-site mechanism evidence; EC 2.3.1 is scope only.
Do not merge hydrolase side-EC rows, water-acceptor chemistry, or generic transferases without CoA/acyl-CoA mechanism evidence into this family.
Do not merge methyltransferase, glycosyltransferase, phosphoryl-transfer, or non-CoA acyl carrier chemistry into CoA acyl transfer solely by transferase wording.
The CoA/acyl-CoA donor and acceptor substrate are dissociable ligands; their absence in apo structures is the declared deploy-missing context.

families.name: Cofactor-independent isomerization chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by Rhea isomerization equation/participant or Isomerase keyword/domain plus active-/binding-site/base evidence; EC 5.3 is scope only.
Do not admit EC-only rows or rows with non-5.3 side ECs unless a future subclass rule explicitly owns the boundary chemistry.
Hold transferase, peroxidase, hydrolase, oxidoreductase, and protein disulfide isomerase/thiol-redox side rows out of the generic cofactor-independent isomerase label.
The substrate/proton-transfer state is deploy-missing and must remain review-only admission evidence until source-free geometry or grafted context supports silver promotion.

families.name: Non-PLP racemase and epimerase chemistry
family_boundary_guardrails: Membership is decided by EC 5.1 scope plus Isomerase keyword and racemase/epimerase/mutarotase mechanism text with Rhea isomerization/racemization, active-/binding-site, metal, or cofactorless corroboration; EC is scope only.
Do not admit PLP/pyridoxal-phosphate racemases or rows with transferase, hydrolase, oxidoreductase, or non-5.1 side ECs.
Hold EC-only rows and multi-fingerprint-signal rows rather than forcing a stereochemical isomerization label.

The substrate stereocenter, proton-transfer state, and any catalytic metal/water context are deploy-missing and must remain review-only admission evidence until source-free geometry or grafted context supports silver promotion.

propagation_guardrails.rule: Family propagation requires shared mechanism family plus conserved catalytic role signatures; sequence cluster membership alone cannot promote labels above bronze.
Domain architecture can raise review priority but cannot promote across ontology families without reaction-center agreement.
Family annotations must be treated as weak evidence when mechanism text or cofactor evidence conflicts with the seed fingerprint.

When UniRef/CATH/InterPro are unavailable, use entry name, M-CSA mechanism text, cofactor ligands, and pocket geometry as auditable local proxies; keep propagated labels bronze until direct evidence promotes them.
